title.narrative: Promoting local dialogue for disability inclusive livelihood and social cohesion in Upper Egypt

description.narrative: The action aims at empowering the El-Ber DPO to contribute to the improvement of the livelihoods of vulnerable households living with disabilities in El Qusiya district, through a multi-stakeholder approach engaging civil society, private sectors and local authorities of Assiut governorate. The project intends to tackle the widespread perception that vulnerable households, in particular those living with disabilities, do not have the capacity to engage in innovatory productive projects contributing to the wealth of local communities and must be considered as passive recipients of aid rather than active economic contributors.
